info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Result rankings API
Get a List of Result Ranking Rules

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target Coveo Cloud organization.

Specifying a value for this parameter is only necessary when you are authenticating the API call with an OAuth2 token.

params.name: pipelineId
params.description: The unique identifier of the target query pipeline.

params.name: kind
params.description:
The kind of result ranking rules to allow in the returned list (i.e., `featured_result` or `ranking_expression`).

By default, both kinds of rules are allowed.

**Deprecated:** Use `ruleTypes` instead.

params.name: enabledStatus
params.description:
The enabled status of result ranking rules to allow in the returned list.

Set to `true` to only allow rules whose `enabled` property is set to `true`, and vice versa.

By default, both enabled and disabled rules are allowed.

**Deprecated:** Use `ruleStatuses` instead.

params.name: statementGroupId
params.description: The unique identifier of the statement group.

params.name: isOrderAscending
params.description: Whether to sort the results in ascending order.

params.name: ruleStatuses
params.description:
The rule status to allow in the results. Available statuses are: "active", "inactive".

If you leave this parameter undefined, all rule statuses will be allowed in the results. If you pass an empty array (`[]`), no rules will be returned.

params.name: filter
params.description:
The query filter to match.

This allows you to search within query pipeline statement definitions and descriptions.

By default, results are not required to match a specific query filter.

params.name: ruleTypes
params.description:
The rule types to allow in the results. Available types are "featuredResults", "rankingExpressions".
If you leave this parameter undefined, all rule types will be allowed in the results. If you pass an empty array (`[]`), no rules will be returned.

params.name: associatedGroups
params.description: The group names to allow in the results. Include the `null` value in the array to allow rules that are not associated with any groups (e.g., `[null, "mygroup"]`). If you leave this parameter undefined, all groups will be allowed in the results. If you pass an empty array (`[]`), no rules will be returned.

params.name: expand
params.description:
The related resources to expand in the response.

Set to `condition.detailed` to include the detailed version of the condition alongside `condition.reference` in each result ranking condition.

params.name: page
params.description: The 0-based number of the page of results to get.

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of results to include per page.
